outcome: Need for more than one induction agent
Failure to achieve vaginal delivery within 24 hours
cohort: 1671 women with singleton cephalic fetus, unscarred uterus, and bishop score <7
finding: In current practice, no cervical ripening method appears clearly superior to the others considering all effectiveness and safety outcomes.
mod_finding: This study found that in current practice, no single cervical ripening method for induction of labor appears superior to the others when considering all effectiveness and safety outcomes, including caesarean delivery.
